source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.13, printed pages 226-227.

blocks.text: Electrochemical cell ka voltage concentration, darja hararat aur kisi gas ke dabao par bhi munhasir hai, to electrode potentials ka muqabla karte waqt standard halaat istemal hote hain: ions 1.00 mol dm-3 par, darja hararat 25 degrees C (298 K), gases 1 atmosphere (101 kPa) par, aur half-cell ka electrode potential standard hydrogen electrode ke muqable napa hua. In halaat mein electrode potential standard electrode potential hai, symbol E standard, jise 'E standard' bola jata hai.

blocks.title: Standard electrode potential
blocks.text: Kisi half-cell ka standard electrode potential woh voltage hai jo standard halaat mein standard hydrogen electrode ko doosra half-cell bana kar napa jaye.

blocks.prompt: E standard ki tareef mein darja hararat aur concentration kyun muqarrar hain?
blocks.explanation: Electrode equilibrium, jaise Cu2+ + 2e- = Cu, ion concentration aur darja hararat ke saath shift hota hai, to voltage un ke saath badalta hai. 1.00 mol dm-3, 298 K aur 101 kPa muqarrar karna mukhtalif half-cells ki qeematon ko qabil-e-muqabla banata aur unhen table mein likhne deta hai.

items: Standard halaat: 1.00 mol dm-3, 298 K, 101 kPa, SHE ke muqable; yun napa voltage E standard hai.
